title: hoya acuminata
intro: Hoya acuminata, commonly known as the Waxflower or Porcelain Flower, is a species of flowering plant in the dogbane family, Apocynaceae. The health benefits of Hoya acuminata include its potential in reducing anxiety and stress, promoting relaxation, and aiding in the regulation of sleep patterns. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins that exhibit sedative, anxiolytic, and antioxidant properties. Research on the bioactive constituents of Hoya acuminata has identified compounds such as voacangine and voacristine, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
